sanskrit_verse: सवर्णा भिन्नसंख्या ये पुंभागस् तेषु शस्यते / पितामह्यस् तु सर्वास् ता मातृतुल्याः प्रकीर्तिताः // BrhS_1,26.25
transliteration: savarṇā bhinna-saṃkhyā ye puṃ-bhāgas teṣu śasyate / pitāmahiyaḥ tu sarvās tā mātṛ-tulyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: Women of the same varṇa but differing in number among male descendants are to be apportioned accordingly; however, all paternal aunts are declared equal to maternal aunts in status and entitlement.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious relational alignment, not numerical distribution
Causation is rooted in dharmic recognition, not biological lineage alone
Capacity-based responsibility arises from relational integrity, not gendered position
Restoration logic prioritizes familial harmony over structural inheritance
Consciousness alignment determines equity, not social construct
executable_legal_axioms: IF female kin belong to same varṇa AND differ numerically among male heirs THEN allocate share proportionally based on relational proximity AND dharma-preserving criteria
IF individual is paternal aunt THEN grant status EQUAL TO maternal aunt REGARDLESS OF lineage count
IF dispute arises in allocation THEN prioritize completion of family unity over asset division
IF capacity for relation exists THEN entitlement follows automatically without punitive validation
supreme_court_application: In matters of inheritance or familial rights, the Supreme Court shall recognize relational parity between paternal and maternal aunts as fundamental to dharma-based equity. Numerical disparities among male heirs must not override conscious relational structures that uphold family coherence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes relational truth beyond numerical appearance. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through harmonious succession, where each relative's role supports cosmic balance. Responsibility aligns with capacity to sustain unity, not inflict correction. Non-punitive reality rule ensures outcomes reflect dharma, not legal domination.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Family Reconciliation Protocol to restore relational clarity before adjudication
Assign Completion Facilitator to ensure emotional and energetic resolution among parties
Activate Conscious Entitlement Recognition process to affirm inherent relational value
Implement Unity Restoration Framework to prevent fragmentation of familial dharma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through relational recognition, not punitive hierarchy. Reality remains non-punitive, sustained by consciousness as the supreme adjudicator.
